text:
# About iOS 27 Updates

iOS 27 introduces the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, as well as new features to help parents create safe digital experiences for kids, and improvements that make iOS more responsive and delightful to use. Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri that is more intelligent, knowledgeable, and capable. The next generation of Apple Intelligence also powers new features across apps that simplify the things you do every day, like editing images in Photos, communicating in Messages and Mail, and browsing in Safari. New parental controls and significant updates to Screen Time make it more intuitive and easy to use, so parents can feel confident that they're building the right digital experience for their child. And with improvements that span design, performance, connectivity, search, and more, the experience on iOS 27 has been refined and elevated, so it feels even better to use.

## iOS 27.2

This update provides enhancements to Siri AI with the ability to retain useful context from previous Siri interactions as well as draw from a wider range of personal context. It also introduces Suggestions in Messages that help you take quick actions in apps like Calendar and Reminders based on context from your conversation. This release includes additional features, bug fixes, and security updates for your iPhone.

title: Apple Releases iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 [Download] - iClarified
text:
# Apple Releases iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 [Download]

Posted November 9, 2026 at 6:17pm by Shalom Levytam

Apple has released iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1. The iPhone update provides bug fixes and security updates.

The standard iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 firmware downloads carry build number 24B156. The new iPad mini uses build 24B8156, while the iPhone Duo version carries build number 24B91034. The releases follow iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2, issued on October 26.

For devices on earlier software versions, iOS 26.7.3 and iPadOS 26.7.3 carry build number 23H131. Apple has also released iOS 18.7.12 and iPadOS 18.7.12 with build number 22H390.

To install the updates, open Settings > General > Software Update on your iPhone or iPad. Firmware links are available on our iPhone and iPad download pages, or through the iClarified IPSW Wizard.
